sentences.text: Unknown vs State V. Dometi Devi on 11 January, 2023

Author: Sandeep Sharma
Bench: Sandeep Sharma
State v. Dometi Devi .
Rfa No. 475 of 2019 11.1.2023 Present Mr. Rajan Kahol and Mr. B.C. Verma, Additional Advocates
General, for the appellant.
Mr. O.C. Sharma, Advocate, for the respondents.
By way of instant application, prayer has been made on behalf of respondents Nos. 1 to 4 for release of the award amount lying deposited with the Registry of this Court.
No reply is intended to be filed by learned Additional Advocate General.
Learned Additional Advocate General fairly states that some reasonable amount may be ordered to be released in favour of the respondents during the pendency of the appeal.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the material available on record, this court finds that land of the respondents came to be acquired for the construction of Sundernagar- Dharanda-Hilra road and in this regard, Notification under S.4 of Land Acquisition Act was published in Rajpatra on 11.3.2005.
Though the land stands utilized for the construction of road supra, but till date, amount on account of compensation has not been released in favour of the respondents.

Though amount awarded by Collector stands further enhanced by learned District Judge, while deciding the reference petition, but since appellants have approached this Court in the instant proceedings, laying therein challenge to award passed by reference court, amount lying deposited in the Registry of this Court is not being released in favour of the respondents.

Since the land already stands acquired and in similar cases, this court has ordered for release of the 50% of award amount to the claimants, this court sees no impediment in accepting the prayer .
made in the application and same is allowed.
Registry is directed to release 50% of the amount lying deposited with it and remit the same into the savings bank account of the respondents, details whereof are given in Annexure P-2 to P-5, subject to verification by the Accounts Branch.
Needless to say, remaining amount shall be invested in FDR till further orders.
